Name: Nature Furniture
Author: BlatantDecoy
Description:
Decorate your farm with Nature.

Adds the following furniture to the game:
[list]
[*]Tree Stump
[*]Hollow Log
[*]Big Rocks (All variations)
[*]Meteorite
[/list]
Available in Robin's shop for 3000 each (customisable in the content.json), or through the furniture catalogue.

Note that these are added as [b]Imitation Furniture[/b] and can not be harvested for rewards.

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture Mod[/url]
To place outdoors you require [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276]Furniture Anywhere[/url] & the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254?tab=files]Custom Furniture Anywhere[/url] addon.


Optional version for JA makes the furniture into a two part BigCraftable. This requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]﻿. Port created by Geminia.
